title: Preferences
collapseEffectDescription: Choose how the sidebar displays when collapsed
iconModeDescription: Icon Mode: Show only icons when collapsed, click to expand submenu
expandedSubmenuModeDescription: Expanded Submenu Mode: Show icons and all submenu items when collapsed
showBreadcrumbsDescription: Show breadcrumb navigation when tabs are disabled
enableTabsDescription: Enable multi-tab navigation, disable to show breadcrumbs
enableKeepAliveDescription: When enabled, preserve page state and DOM structure when switching tabs
themeModeDescription: Switch between light and dark theme
